summary.text: Spencer Sommers is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives District 3 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Tim Hanigan and against Democrat Erin Rudner.
Sommers finished first in the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, defeating incumbent Al Novstrup and Kaleb Weis.
